meta.title: useMemo — skipping an expensive recalculation

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: FilterList re-filters a list as the query changes. useMemo caches the result so the filter only runs when its inputs actually change.

annotations.label: Cached computation
annotations.detail: The memo callback closes over query. ITEMS is defined outside the component so its reference is always the same — only query drives recalculation.

steps.note: useMemo caches the return value between renders. React checks each dep by Object.is; only when query changes does it re-run expensiveFilter.
